_comment: Primitive value providers. These carry an editable literal in one input and feed it into another node's widget. They are not exposed directly; instead `value_source.input` tells recognition which input to follow to when another node's exposed input is wired from one of these (e.g. a CLIPTextEncode.text fed by a PrimitiveStringMultiline). The control's identity and kind come from the consuming node's entry, not from here.
